name: CADEX
verdict: Being rated: a maintainer decides whether the US customs Withhold Release Order against Giant counts as a forced-labour finding.
note: Giant's high-performance components brand (wheels, cockpits); on the Liv AlUla Jayco 2026 jersey sleeve. Giant Group's corporate site lists CADEX among its product brands (giantgroup-cycling.com, opened 2026-10-03). Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. In September 2025 US Customs and Border Protection issued a Withhold Release Order against Giant Manufacturing's Taiwan-made bicycles, parts and accessories, on information that reasonably indicates forced labour (claim giant-manufacturing-wro-2025; CBP's release says its investigation identified ILO forced-labour indicators including debt bondage and withholding of wages). If that counts as a regulator finding of forced labour by the company, the tier is concern. Giant Manufacturing's large shareholders are not traced in the claims.
